structured_info.title: Model Predictive Control (Receding Horizon Control)
structured_info.summary: Optimizes a finite prediction horizon N_p while applying only the first control step u(k).
structured_info.objective_function: min J = sum(||w_x * (r(k+i) - y(k+i))||^2) + sum(||w_u * Delta u(k+j)||^2)
invariants: Actuator Slew Rate Bound: |Delta u(k)| <= Delta u_max (prevents mechanical shock)
Manipulated Variable Ceiling: u_min <= u(k) <= u_max
State Safety Envelope: y_min <= y(k) <= y_max
Terminal Stability Invariant: x(k + N_p) in X_terminal
execution_steps: 1. State Ingestion: Sample plant state vector x(k) from sensors
2. Trajectory Projection: Predict future outputs y(k+i) over prediction horizon N_p
3. Constrained Optimization: Solve QP subject to state and input inequality constraints
4. Boundary Verification: Inspect optimal trajectory against invariant tripwires
5. Receding Horizon Dispatch: Apply first control input u*(k) to actuator
6. Horizon Step: Advance time k <- k + 1 and repeat
tripwires: QP Solver Infeasibility -> Trigger Safe Fallback Controller
Actuator Rate Violation -> Clamp Delta u to Slew Ceiling
State Constraint Exceeded -> Emergency Trip & Hold Safe State

nodes.label: Constrained QP Solver [min J]
nodes.formula: min sum(e^T Q e + Delta u^T R Delta u)

nodes.label: Feasibility & Invariant Check
nodes.formula: u_min <= u <= u_max & |Delta u| <= Delta u_max
